operator_sign_off.note: Set true only after an operator has reviewed this book's classification pass, per docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's DRAFT header.

screening_method_note: This pass is a heuristic first-pass screen of every `description` value against a bounded, documented term list (the same 54 PI_BLACKLIST_TERMS src/bin/sd27_gen_book_cache.rs's gen_pathfinder_unchained() also uses -- the 20 canonical core Golarion deities plus a sampled set of known setting place names, matching docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md's operating cycle for the 4 in-scope books' retro-fit). Scan result for this book: all 635 records screened, all matched OGL, 0 PI hits. Provenance of that total, stated per slice rather than as one undifferentiated number: 200 equipment + 187 feats + 92 spells were screened 2026-07-27 by gen_advanced_race_guide() itself; the 156 alternate/default racial traits were written 2026-07-31 by src/bin/ingest_race_traits_arg.rs, which -- unlike src/bin/ingest_pu_classes.rs and src/bin/ingest_races.rs -- classifies every record OGL WITHOUT running the term scan, so their classification was re-derived on 2026-07-31 by running the identical 54-term substring scan over every one of the 156 records' `description` values (0 hits). Adding that screen to ingest_race_traits_arg.rs is an open finding: today the classification is correct but the binary does not check it. The count above was stale at 479 until 2026-07-31 because it was written from what one generator emitted rather than from the book's record set; tests/sd27_book_license_record_counts.rs now derives it from disk so that cannot silently recur. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan against 54 known names and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see.
